data.long_meaning: Devi, the goddess of gods, is the source of all creation, preservation, and destruction. The name Devika is derived from the Sanskrit word Devi, meaning 'goddess'. The name Devika carries the meaning “Goddess of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi.
